name: Haruki Daisuke
source:
Daisuke is [url=/c174567]Haru’s[/url] older twin brother. He wants to help his little sister and warns her of the danger, but Haru is too afraid of becoming an outcast in class to heed his warning. 

Daisuke grew up gloomy, unsociable, and sarcastic, but quite friendly. He worries about his loved ones and secretly protects them by crafting amulets against evil. 

He tried to learn to play the guitar; however, Haru said she would set the house on fire if he didn’t stop torturing her ears.

[i]"I don't want to go back there".[/i] 

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
